newsitem.title: USA: Ford sees sustained vehicle sales momentum.
newsitem.headline: Ford sees sustained vehicle sales momentum.

text.p: Ford Motor Co Chief Financial Officer John Devine said he expects the U.S. total vehicle market in 1998 to continue at approximately the same pace as it has in 1997.

Devine, speaking to reporters at Ford's corporate headquarters, said the automaker expects the industry to be on pace for the low 15 million vehicle range in the second half of 1997. Ford has projected the total year to be 15-15.5 million. "We don't think it's over," he said. "We think the economy has long legs and really can sustain the kind of improvements we're seeing," he said.
